problem_text:
A logistics company must dispatch a technician to perform maintenance at four separate facilities:

Facility Alpha: Positioned at grid reference (23,20)  
Facility Beta: Positioned at grid reference (81,130)  
Facility Gamma: Positioned at grid reference (125,27)  
Facility Delta: Positioned at grid reference (77,141)

The travel distances between facilities, measured in kilometers, are precomputed as follows:  
Alpha to Gamma: 102.2 km  
Alpha to Delta: 132.5 km  
Beta to Gamma: 112.0 km  
Beta to Delta: 11.7 km  
Gamma to Delta: 123.7 km  

Due to geographical obstacles, a direct route between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta is unavailable.  
Furthermore, the planned circuit must incorporate exactly one of two specified critical links: either the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed loop that visits every facility precisely once and concludes at the point of origin.
